permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.overviewExplanation: Every permission this client actually has in the chosen channel, and which layer each one comes from. Where several layers grant the same permission, the winning one is highlighted, following the tier order in TeamSpeak's own permission documentation: client-in-channel beats channel group, beats channel, beats client, beats server group - with a Skip flag on a server group or client entry shielding it from the channel and channel group layers. The other sources stay listed so the result can always be checked by eye.

permissions.chooseChannelHint: Choose a channel to see their permissions in it
permissions.noPermissionsApply: No permissions apply to this client in this channel
permissions.findExplanation: Pick a permission on the left to see every place it's actually assigned, across all five tiers. Click a result to open it in the editor. TeamSpeak's own lookup only reports where a permission is set, not to what - each value below is read back per entity afterwards.

permissions.compareHintAutoRank: All permissions are shown by default ("Add/Remove Perm" to narrow down, the × on a row to drop it) - edit a cell to change just that one entity. With 3 or fewer entities, each row colors by rank automatically: red = highest, yellow = tied/middle, green = lowest, pink = unset.
permissions.compareHintPivot: All permissions are shown by default ("Add/Remove Perm" to narrow down, the × on a row to drop it) - edit a cell to change just that one entity. Click a cell to pin it as the reference; the rest of that row colors relative to it (teal = lower, lime = same, red = higher, pink = unset).
permissions.compareHintSuffix: "Add Target" loads a previously-exported group file as a read-only extra column. Use Bulk Apply instead to push the same value to all selected entities at once.

temp.storeAsIntro: WebQuery and HTTP Request actions have a "Store As" field. The FULL result list is saved as a temp variable — even a single-row command like clientinfo or serverinfo, so access it with an explicit <1>.0.</1> for "the first (only) row".
temp.loopIntro: A Loop node reads an existing list (e.g. a "Store As" result from a clientlist WebQuery) and runs its "Body" output once per item, then its "After" output once when done.

loopItem.desc: Current item (whatever name the Loop node's Item Variable Name is set to), inside its Body branch only

loopField.desc: A field of the current item - item variable name + "." + field (no .0 here, unlike Store As above - a single object per iteration, not a list)

loopIndex.desc: Position of the current item in the list, starting at 0

exec.intro: Read-only metadata about the current flow execution.

flowId.desc: ID of the flow being executed

filter.intro: Filters transform values. Apply with pipe syntax: <1>{{value|filter}}</1>

functions.intro: Functions for use in <1>Condition</1> node expressions. Return 0 or 1 (false/true).

contains.desc: String contains substring? (plain substring match - see hasGroup below for numeric ID lists)

split.desc: Split string and get element at index

hasGroup.desc: Exact match against a comma-separated ID list - use this for server group IDs, not contains(), which would wrongly match group '1' against '10' or '21' too

count.desc: Row count of a stored WebQuery result (array), or string length otherwise - use to check whether a lookup found anything

templates.intro: Extra placeholders specific templates from the Template Gallery resolve automatically, beyond the general ones above.

editChannelDialog.title: Edit Channel
editChannelDialog.loadFailed: Failed to load full channel settings
editChannelDialog.codecQualityHint: 0 = lowest, 10 = highest. Higher quality uses more bandwidth.
editChannelDialog.encryptVoice: Encrypt voice data in this channel
editChannelDialog.defaultChannelHint: A server has only one default channel — enabling this removes the flag from whichever channel currently has it.
editChannelDialog.maxFamilyClientsHint: Limits clients across this channel and all its sub-channels combined.

infoChannels.label: Info Channels
infoChannels.description: Dynamic channel names with live data

clockChannel.name: Clock Channel
clockChannel.description: Updates a channel name with the current time every minute.

onlineCounter.name: Online Counter
onlineCounter.description: Shows the current online client count in a channel name.

serverStats.name: Server Stats
serverStats.description: Displays uptime, online clients, and channel count in three info channels.

animatedChannel.name: Animated Channel Name
animatedChannel.description: Animates a channel name with visual effects like scrolling marquee, typewriter, bounce, and more. Updates every 2-5 seconds.

welcomeMessage.name: Welcome Message
welcomeMessage.description: Sends a welcome message or poke when a client joins the server, with an opt-out command and server-group exclusions.
variablesHint: {{temp.onlineCount}} - real users online right now (query/bot connections not counted)
{{temp.teamOnline}} - team members online right now (only resolves if Team Groups is set below)

supportSystem.name: Support System
supportSystem.description: Notifies admins when a client joins the support channel.

privateChannelCreator.name: Private Channel Creator
privateChannelCreator.description: Creates a persistent private channel for a client on first joining a lobby, and moves them back to it every time after - with them set as its channel owner.
variablesHint: {{temp.joinerInfo.0.client_nickname}} - joining client's name (for the channel name/description template)

parentChannelId.label: Parent Channel ID (optional - overrides where channels are created)

channelAdminGroupId.label: Channel Admin Group ID (assigned as owner)

spamProtectionEnabled.label: Spam Protection (ban clients who repeatedly rejoin the lobby)

autoRank.name: Auto-Rank
autoRank.description: Automatically assigns server groups based on cumulative online time.

lastSeenTracker.name: Last-Seen Tracker
lastSeenTracker.description: Records the last-seen timestamp when a client disconnects.

afkMover.name: AFK Mover
afkMover.description: Moves idle clients to an AFK channel after a configurable timeout.

idleKicker.name: Idle Kicker
idleKicker.description: Kicks clients that have been idle for too long.

badNameChecker.name: Bad Name Checker
badNameChecker.description: Kicks clients whose nickname contains forbidden words.

groupProtector.name: Group Protector
groupProtector.description: Kicks clients who have a protected group but lack the required authorization group.

webhookServerMessage.name: Webhook → Server Message
webhookServerMessage.description: Receives a webhook POST and broadcasts the message to the TeamSpeak server. Great for monitoring alerts, CI/CD notifications, or Discord bridges.

webhookGroupAssign.name: Webhook → Assign Group
webhookGroupAssign.description: External system (e.g. website verification) sends a webhook with a client database ID to assign a server group. Use for website-to-TS3 user verification.

webhookChannelRename.name: Webhook → Update Channel
webhookChannelRename.description: Receives a webhook and updates a channel name. Use for external status displays like game server status, stream status, or monitoring dashboards.

antiVpn.name: Anti-VPN
antiVpn.description: Checks connecting clients against a VPN detection API and kicks/bans VPN users.
